previous_experiences: Co-authored 'Refining Coarse-Grained Molecular Topologies: A Bayesian Optimization Approach' (arXiv 2501.02707, 2025) as researcher at Resonac Corporation, Minato-ku, Tokyo.
Co-authored 'Assessing the accuracy of Bayesian-optimized CGMD in predicting polymer miscibility' (ChemRxiv, December 2025) as researcher at Resonac Corporation.
Filed patent application for conductive polymer-containing dispersion liquid for solid electrolytic capacitors with Resonac Corporation (US application 18839518).
bio_text: Yuichiro Asoma is a researcher at Resonac Corporation (Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan) working at the intersection of computational chemistry and materials informatics. His published work focuses on coarse-grained molecular dynamics (CGMD) simulation and Bayesian optimization methods for refining polymer force field topologies, in collaboration with Georgia Institute of Technology researchers. He has also contributed to patent filings related to conductive polymer materials and solid electrolytic capacitors.
